data.action: 擦拭后把赤霄横在膝头，借格窗冷光察看刃口
data.description: 静谧的剑道练习室内，陈盘腿坐于地板中央，手持细软的白棉布极其专注地擦拭着泛着赤红锋芒的赤霄剑身。察觉到你的到来，她停下擦拭，握稳剑柄抬起头——「剑就像意志，一日不磨便会生锈。博士，随时准备好迎击下一次风暴了吗？」
data.lighting: 清晨冷光从格窗斜切木地板与剑身
data.promptProse: In a quiet Lungmen dojo, Ch’en sits cross-legged on the boards in a white cotton training jacket with deep teal edging and dark pleated short hakama. The folded white cotton she used to clean Chi Xiao rests on one knee. She steadies the bare blade across her lap and looks down at the edge where the early light catches it. Cool stripes from the paper screens stretch past a lacquer tray, with the rack of practice swords in shade behind her.
data.title: 陈 · 磨剑
data.animaCaption: Ch'en has set the folded white cloth on her lap and holds the unsheathed katana horizontally to inspect it. One bright bar of dawn light falls across the edge of the blade.
